title: Accept zip-tool paths like photos/../cover.jpg
body: Some zip tools write paths with ".." after a folder. They were rejected as invalid file paths; keep them now.

source.note: Synthetic: written for this benchmark against 892ddf8.

note: normalizeRelativePath keeps ".." after the first segment.

expected.description: A ".." after a folder is now kept, so "photos/../../evil.sh" passes normalizeRelativePath; it is stored as the file's path and written as a zip entry name, so extracting the "Download all" zip writes outside the target folder (zip slip). The existing spec expects photos/../../a.jpg to be rejected.
